    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    # Set parameters
    k = params[0]  # stiffness
    b_0 = params[1]  # viscous damping coefficient

    b_a = params[3]  # nonlinear damping coefficient due to asymmetry
    A_c = params[4]  # nonlinear stiffness coefficient
    b_b = params[5]  # Bouc-Wen (BW) damping coefficient

    E = params[7]  # energy storage in BW damping
    h = params[8]  # time constant for energy storage
    rho = params[9]  # ratio of energy dissipation rate to rate of energy storage
    pi = params[10]  # phase shift
    omega_d = params[11]  # damping frequency
    omega_f = params[12]  # driving frequency
    ω_b = params[13]  # nonlinear frequency
    ω_c = params[14]  # critical frequency
